audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls Levels 4-5 and first item even and hands the 2-item stage to Fiora — the opposite of what the page's own text and the packet say.
audit.why: whys[3] and whys[5] describe Fiora chaining Lunges and forcing the splitpush (Fiora), whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say two tank items flip it to K'Sante. packet.levelChart is Fiora x6 then K'Sante, at a 56.27% win rate.
audit.corrected: win[3], win[5] and phases[3], phases[5] -> Fiora; win[6] and phases[6] -> K'Sante, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out is the tracked spell everywhere with no cooldown, and Path Maker / Footwork timings are never given.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80, Path Maker 14/13/12/11/10, Footwork 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Ntofo Strikes a flat 3.5s; Fiora R is 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry 120s, 14s, 10s and 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly calls the parry target his 'third-cast Q knockup'. Ntofo Strikes fires its shockwave at TWO stacks and it PULLS, not knocks up. Footwork's shield is never mentioned, and neither is the fact that All Out removes Path Maker's knockback and stun.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in'; E 'dashes and gains a shield'; W 'When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns'. That last one matters — once he ults there is no immobilize on W to convert into a Riposte stun.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and dosFull[2] now name the two-stack Ntofo pull; dosFull[1].d states the 10s Footwork shield; dontsFull[2].d states Path Maker loses its stun in All Out. Riposte still returns a stun off the pull and off a non-All-Out Path Maker — both are immobilizing.

edits.before: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone wins the all-in; bait his Q knockup, parry it with Riposte for the return stun, and the duel is free.
edits.after: Grand Challenge marks all four Vitals and the heal zone wins the all-in; bait his two-stack Ntofo pull, parry it for the return stun, and the duel is free.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Duel when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, and it strips his own armour and MR into your true damage. - Path Maker: 14s block-dash. - Grand Challenge: 110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Duel when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His duelist mode — 120s at rank 1, and All Out strips his own resists.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on K'Sante, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Footwork shields him every 10s at rank 1 — bait the dash-shield out, then Q-lunge the vital and E-slow away.

edits.before: K'Sante wastes All Out — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Ntofo Strikes pulls at two stacks — parry that, not an auto.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: All Out heals him — Grievous Wounds before you commit at 6.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Path Maker (14s) blocks damage while he charges — wait it out; in All Out it stops stunning, so there is nothing to parry.

notes: 'Third-cast Q knockup' also appears in whys[2], early, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] — Ntofo Strikes shockwaves at TWO stacks and pulls rather than knocking up. I fixed the spike and the do; the remaining four are prose I could not shorten into band without dropping other content, so they need a manual pass. dontsFull[0].t 'Get walled by his Q' is under 25 chars (applier skips it) and is also wrong — the wall-launch is his R, not his Q.
